phrase.zh: 衍射的斑点，透露内部的排列。
phrase.en: Diffraction spots hint at inner order.

visual.zh: 晶格般的结构与点阵光斑在画中重叠，表现从散射图样反推晶体排列。点位不是任何物质的衍射照片。
visual.en: Lattice-like forms overlap spot patterns, suggesting how diffraction informs crystal structure. The spots are not a diffraction photograph of any substance.

background.zh: 1912 年，晶体对 X 射线的衍射实验开启了用波来研究晶体内部排列的道路。随后布拉格父子发展了晶体结构分析；从斑点推断结构需要实验几何、数据和模型。
background.en: X-ray diffraction experiments with crystals in 1912 opened a way to study inner atomic arrangements. The Braggs then advanced crystal-structure analysis; interpreting spots requires experimental geometry, data and models.

sources.label: International Union of Crystallography · X-ray diffraction
